title: Clyde Tombaugh's ashes on New Horizons

tellings.quote: But, in fact, the most embarrassing thing was New Horizons, which was sent to explore Pluto. Mhm. And uh NASA decided to put uh 30 g of ashes of the person who discovered Pluto, Clyde Tombaugh, the scientist.

plain: When NASA sent its New Horizons spacecraft off to explore Pluto, it put about 30 grams of the ashes of Clyde Tombaugh, the scientist who discovered Pluto, on board. That is how the Harvard scientist Avi Loeb tells it to Michels, and he calls it "the most embarrassing thing" humans have sent into space, without naming a source.
